system.description: Only an Imperial engineer could be so ingenious as to build a firearm into so cunning a prosthetic! Careful when shaking hands. Damage Rating: 5 Critical Rating: 2 Group: Black Powder Qualities: Pierce 1, Reload, Unreliable 2 Range: Close Encumbrance: 4 The Finger-gun also functions as a prosthetic, allowing the wearer to act as if he had two hands with a @ penalty to actions of greater than Trivial (0d) difficulty.
